What we do / izzyLabs

From what if.
To what's next.

We bring direction, design and development together to turn ideas into digital products people want to use.

01

Find the direction.

Make the right thing before making the thing right. We help shape the problem, the audience and a clear first version.

  • Product discovery
  • MVP definition
  • Product roadmaps
02

Design the experience.

Clear flows. Thoughtful details. Interfaces that make complex ideas feel simple, from the first sketch to the final screen.

  • User experience
  • Interface design
  • Prototypes & design systems
03

Bring it to life.

Connect the design to a working product. We build websites and applications with the care to carry the idea through.

  • Web development
  • Mobile applications
  • APIs & integrations
04

Make it work smarter.

Put useful intelligence where it belongs. Explore AI features and automation that reduce friction in everyday tasks.

  • AI integration
  • Workflow automation
  • Product experiments
05

Care for the details.

Check the journeys, test the edges and keep improving. A launch is a starting point for learning what works.

  • Quality assurance
  • Application testing
  • Product refinement

About us / izzyLabs

Independent minds.
Shared ambition.

izzyLabs is a home for ideas, products and the people building them. We create ventures of our own and help others bring theirs to life.

One company. Two ways to build.

We think like founders.
We work like partners.

Building our own products keeps us close to the questions every founder faces: what matters, what comes first, and how to make something useful. We bring that same curiosity and care to our client work.

Our own products, shaped from the first question onward. Glow explores a simpler way to book beauty and self-care. CareNearby brings care services closer to the people who need them.

The idea

A little closer.
A lot more human.

Finding support for someone you love should feel personal. CareNearby brings families and personal support workers together in Greater Sudbury, with discovery, booking and updates in one place.

As an izzyLabs original, it brings product design and development around a simple ambition: make the next step feel clear.

Familiar by design.Built for everyday life.
